row.body: The discount card is stamped paid before the watch stock was counted; the closing sheet says every customer left before the store was checked.
row.title: The watch discount card

sidecar.gloss: A sale closes before stock and room checks are complete.
sidecar.rival_reading: A sales clerk could complete a transaction before the stock count; the sheet does not prove a customer was left inside.

row.body: the comb and hand torch are wedged beneath unused warning tape. footprints pass around the bundle rather than toward it.
row.title: missing count beside the comb

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
